title: $\mathcal{F}$-Transitivity of Translation Semigroups on Directed Metric Trees
summary: We study the $\mathcal F$-transitivity and topological $\mathcal F$-recurrence of left translation semigroups on weighted $L^p$-spaces over directed metric trees. Motivated by the recent work of Mangino and Vargas-Moreno on hypercyclicity and weak mixing for these semigroups, we investigate the different problem of $\mathcal F$-transitivity, where the entire return-time set is required to belong to a prescribed finitely invariant Furstenberg family.
